source: Department of National Defence (open data; State of the Canadian Armed Forces) and Statistics Canada (historical)
source_table: DND open data 'CAF Regular Force Members by Rank'; DND 'State of the Canadian Armed Forces'; DND Departmental Results Reports; Statistics Canada Canada Year Book 1988 table 21.16 and table 10-10-0027-01
frequency: annual (fiscal years ending March 31) plus the live page snapshot
transformations: Regular Force 1997– = sum of the open-data by-rank rows per fiscal year
historical constants and Primary Reserve average paid strength from the committed history file (each row cites its source)
live snapshot rows dated by the DND page's 'Last updated'
notes: open-data note: From DRWA Data Mart (updated February 2026); The fiscal years shown are named by the calendar years they end in, e.g., "2020" is fiscal year 19/20 and refers to 31 Mar 2020.
